'''Heroic True Heart of Wood''' (formerly known as '''True Druidic Heart of Wood''') is used for [[True Reincarnation]]: to reset your character's abilities, [[skills]], change their appearance and [[race]] or [[class]] while also gaining [[Past Life Feat|past life]] bonuses, feats and more [[Abilities|ability]] points.

Your character must be [[Level]] 20 or higher to use this item.

A Heroic True Heart of Wood can be acquired in several ways:
* Purchase it in the [[DDO Store]]. These are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.
* Trade {{Tot12|20}} [[Token of the Twelve|Tokens of the Twelve]] (formerly known as Epic Dungeon Tokens) with [[Lahar]], the Epic vendor, outside the [[Tower of the Twelve]]. These are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}.
* Win one in lotteries and special event giveaways. These are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.

'''Caution:''' When purchasing or using a Heart for Reincarnation, be careful to select the one you want - '''''<u>Heroic</u>'' Heart of Wood''' vs. '''''<u>Iconic</u>'' Heart of Wood''', and also a '''Heart of ''<u>Wood</u>''''' vs. a '''Heart of ''<u>Blood</u>'''''.
